Exercise: Seated Side Lateral Raise

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_shoulder_abduction

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- dumbbell

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improving_shoulder_joint_stability
- shoulder_muscle_strengthening

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Rotator cuff issues

Exercise Variations:

- name: Seated Side Lateral Raise with Cable Machine, equipment: cable machine
- name: Seated Side Lateral Raise with Resistance Bands, equipment: resistance bands

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise Standing, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Pick a couple of dumbbells and sit at the end of a flat bench with your feet firmly on the floor. Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing in and your arms straight down at your sides at arms' length. This will be your starting position.
- While maintaining the torso stationary (no swinging), lift the dumbbells to your side with a slight bend on the elbow and the hands slightly tilted forward as if pouring water in a glass. Continue to go up until you arms are parallel to the floor. Exhale as you execute this movement and pause for a second at the top.
- Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to the starting position as you inhale.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
